title: Module map
description: Phase 1 output: one row per exported module, mapping file to module id to screen to audience.

id.description: Unqork module id (24 hex chars) or empty string if unknown

title.description: Human title, from manifest.json where available

type.description: Module type as exported, e.g. ui, api, resource

file.description: Path of the module JSON relative to the export root

screen.description: Screen or route this module renders, if any

visibleTo.description: Role ids that can reach it
